title: Hydrogeologic framework and simulation of shallow ground-water flow in the vicinity of a hazardous-waste landfill near Pinewood, South Carolina
citation: Vroblesky, D.A., 1994, Hydrogeologic framework and simulation of shallow ground-water flow in the vicinity of a hazardous-waste landfill near Pinewood, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 93-4185, map scale 1:34,400.
notes:
USGS WRIR 93-4185 (Vroblesky, 1994), hydrogeologic framework near a hazardous-waste landfill near Pinewood, Sumter County. Simulated (model) heads, leakances, transmissivities, velocities and sensitivity results not recorded. Table 2: only the measured 1989 average water levels recorded (simulated column left out); Lake Marion-2B is listed under both surficial and LS with the same value and recorded once. Laboratory vertical hydraulic conductivities of confining units are printed with exponents lost in the text layer (e.g. '2.6 x 10   ft/d') and are not recorded; potentiometric, thickness and top-of-aquifer figure data points are not legible in the text layer. SUBSURFACE: hydrogeologic section A-A' (figure 3) has no readable scale values.
Pages 71-79 are model sensitivity results and summary (simulated values, not recorded). Plate 1 well labels recorded where legible in OCR; others (e.g. 'PBC-6', 'BCM8') too garbled to read.
